title: Optimal Execution of Portfolio Transactions (Almgren & Chriss)
holding_period: not applicable - this is an execution schedule, typically minutes to days
signal_frequency: one trajectory computed per parent order
data_requirements: own fill data, to replace the rules-of-thumb impact parameters with fitted ones

sources.citation: Almgren, R., & Chriss, N. (2000). Optimal Execution of Portfolio Transactions. Journal of Risk, 3(2), 5-39. (December 2000 draft consulted.)
Almgren, R. (2003). Optimal execution with nonlinear impact functions and trading-enhanced risk. Applied Mathematical Finance, 10(1), 1-18.
Cont, R., Kukanov, A., & Stoikov, S. The price impact of order book events. arXiv:1011.6402. (Argues square-root impact is an aggregation artefact of a linear order-flow relation.)
